title: Yielding Toasted Thai Bamboo Shoot Curry
description: A savory, silky Thai street‑style curry that pairs tender bamboo shoots with a fragrant coconut sauce, finished with toasted bread slices for a crunchy contrast.

ingredients.name: dried bamboo shoots
ingredients.notes: soaked in water for 2 hours, then boiled until tender

instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a claypot over medium heat until shimmering.
Add the sliced onion and sauté until translucent, about 3 minutes.
Stir in the minced garlic and ginger, cooking until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Pour in the red curry paste and stir to coat the aromatics, cooking for 2 minutes.
Add the coconut milk and bring the mixture to a gentle simmer, stirring occasionally.
Fold in the soaked and boiled bamboo shoots, allowing the curry to reduce and thicken for 10 minutes.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste, then stir in the lime juice for brightness.
While the curry simmers, toast the bread slices in a dry skillet until golden, then lightly butter them.
Ladle the hot curry into individual bowls and top each with a toasted bread slice.
Garnish with fresh cilantro if desired, then serve immediately.
